intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryProperties without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Externalized operational values of context Telemetry Ingestion / Stream Processing as an immutable record bound by Spring configuration properties with prefix telemetry (constructor binding, kebab-case keys: reorder-window, reorder-buffer-capacity, validated-stream-capacity, broadcast-capacity, emit-retry-timeout, boundaries). The values live in src/main/resources/application.yml (ApplicationYml unit); no default literal in code. It is registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration through @EnableConfigurationProperties (no @Component here).
